2: Nothing in this Code or the ordinance adopting this Code affects the validity of the herein referenced ordinances or any ordinance amendatory or supplemental thereto. Such ordinances continue in full force and effect as if set out at length in this chapter Nothing in this Code or the ordinance adopting this Code affects the Town of Trion Zoning Ordinance. Unless otherwise and expressly amended therein the Town of Trion Zoning Ordinance shall remain in full force and effect. The Town of Trion Personnel Policy as marked, see Appendix B, as it exists at the time of adoption of this ordinance and its applications to those positions that continue to exist under this Charter and Code of Ordinances. Nothing in this Code or the ordinance adopting this Code affects all ordinances regulating and controlling industrial use of the waste water and waste water facilities. Nothing in this Code or the ordinance adopting this Code affects ordinances adopting the protection of watersheds and recharge areas for protection of watersheds. Nothing in this Code or the ordinance adopting this Code affects legislative acts, contracts and franchises that constitute legal obligations of the Town or obligations of others to the Town. Nothing in this Code or the ordinance adopting this Code affects the legislative acts, ordinances and contracts regulating or pertaining to the operation of the Town of Trion natural gas systems, water systems and sewer system as amended by these ordinances. The existing ordinances are saved from repeal.
